ANALYSIS: Hemophilia A is an inherited coagulation disorder (factor VIII deficiency) causing a systemic bleeding diathesis, often with spontaneous or disproportionate hemarthroses. "Traumatic hemarthrosis of the right knee" describes a localized injury-caused joint bleed (due to intra‑articular trauma), a different etiology and not equivalent to Hemophilia A.
